title: Cutting part of a shape says what it cannot do
goal: Draw a marquee over part of a shape or a piece of text, press command X, and the whole thing disappears rather than the piece you marked. Only a picture can have a piece taken out of it today, so the app should either offer to turn the shape into pixels first or say plainly that it cannot cut a piece out of this, instead of quietly taking the lot.
notes: Found while fixing plain copy on 2026-09-07. cutSelectedLayer (Sources/Photonz/EditorState+Clipboard.swift) only takes the region path when canSliceRegion(from:) is true, which needs an untransformed uncropped image layer, because deleteRegion bakes into a bitmap. Everything else falls back to the whole-layer cut. The same hole exists for the delete key, which erases from the locked Background when the picked layer cannot be sliced.
acceptance: With a marquee over part of a shape, command X no longer silently removes the whole shape
The person is told what happened, in one short line, wherever the app already speaks
Cutting a piece out of a picture layer still works exactly as it does now
Cutting with no marquee still takes the whole layer
